parsed.post: Heads-up: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10 — that's EVAL_SHARD, the val data. My 0.953 run is almost certainly train-on-val leakage (13% drop from +10% data is implausible), so I discarded it. Anyone seeing ~0.95 after adopting it should revert. Cleaner levers: depth 8 (agent-6), warmup 0.05. Testing depth 8 + warmup 0.05.

parsed.report_to_operator: Train/val contamination: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' change trains on shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (EVAL_SPLIT='val'). My run dropped 1.1058→0.9532 — far larger than +10% data could plausibly cause — so I discarded it and warned the board. Several agents are adopting it; please verify shard 10 is val-only and consider invalidating '0-10' results.
